imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The hiking-pants guide uses three accurate category text links; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: Five homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.4, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the submitted sitemap snapshot showed 26 URLs and zero indexed URLs.
searchConsole.decision: The homepage-only sample is too small to support a Data-led item. The batch therefore creates one citation-worthy renter handoff asset and two unrelated evergreen explorations while strengthening three department hubs, twelve reciprocal paths, the Library and sitemap discovery.
searchConsole.ignored: The five homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or another variation of an existing topic.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear only on the hiking-pants guide. The apartment and facial-cleanser guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy apartment move-in condition and handoff record that separates preexisting condition, safety and utility checks, lease obligations, landlord notices, remediation ownership and proof preservation.
authority.cluster: Rental transitions, moving-day evidence and household safety, with reciprocal paths from the moving-day, home-inventory, emergency-document and smoke-alarm guides; the other pages strengthen trail apparel and evidence-aware skin care.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for HUD housing-counselor education and EPA lead and indoor-air education; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life, Style and Grooming: how to document a rental handoff, which hiking-pant system fits a route and climate, and which cleanser label and routine fit a skin-care job. Only the apparel guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
